text: Ponytail 是 DeepSeek Harness 的开发辅助插件，通过技能 provider 将六个可由用户或模型调用的技能加入技能目录，并在会话系统提示词中启用编码模式。它提供最小完整改动指导、代码变更审查、全仓库审计、shortcut 技术债清单、基准收益展示和帮助速查，也可按会话切换 lite、full、ultra 或关闭模式。适合希望精简实现、审查代码或盘点仓库欠账的开发者。需要将插件安装到对应的 Harness profile；不需要额外配置。

Ponytail adds six development skills to DeepSeek Harness and injects coding guidance per session. Skills cover minimal changes, code review, repository audits, shortcut debt, benchmark summaries, and help. Use /ponytail-mode to switch levels or turn off. Install per profile; no extra configuration.
我想让编码任务用更小但完整的改动来解决。
能帮我审查最近的代码改动并指出具体问题吗？
我需要按优先级检查整个仓库的质量。
怎么汇总代码里标记的 shortcut 欠账和后续处理条件？
想查看开发精简方法在公开基准中的代码量和耗时表现。
让 DSH 在每个会话里默认启用编码辅助规则，并能随时切换档位。
我想在 Harness 里通过斜杠菜单调用开发技能。
Help me review a code change and explain concrete findings clearly.
Ponytail 的功能「会话编码模式」：插件在每个会话的系统提示词中注入编码与仓库任务规则，默认 full。使用 /ponytail-mode 可直接切换 lite、full、ultra 或 off；子会话继承父会话档位。
Ponytail 的功能「技能目录」：注册 ponytail、review、audit、debt、gain、help 六项技能，供用户或模型调用。技能以名称和描述列入目录，调用时读取对应 SKILL.md 正文。
Ponytail 的功能「变更审查」：调用 ponytail-review 后检查改动及相关调用路径、测试和 README，按问题重要程度给出具体发现与最小修复建议；只生成报告，不改代码。
Ponytail 的功能「全仓库审计」：调用 ponytail-audit 对指定范围或整个仓库进行检查，按重要性列出问题、修复方向和未检查内容；这项技能只报告，不改动仓库。
Ponytail 的功能「技术债清单」：调用 ponytail-debt 扫描仓库注释中的 shortcut: 或旧 ponytail: 标记，按文件列出简化内容、限制和升级条件，并汇总未设触发条件的条目。
Ponytail 的功能「模式命令」：在会话中运行 /ponytail-mode lite、full、ultra 或 off 可直接改变注入状态；不带参数时显示当前档位，未知选项会返回用法错误。
Ponytail 使用前须知：技能 frontmatter 的 description 只解析单行值；若写成 YAML 折叠或块标量，该技能会被跳过并记录警告。

@shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail README · @shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail · Ponytail for DeepSeek Harness：**中文** | [English](README.en.md)

[Ponytail](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail)（懒人资深开发模式：最小改动解决问题，回复一段话就能看懂）
的 DeepSeek Harness 插件版。一次安装，6 个技能进入 `/` 菜单与模型的 skill 目录，
并且每个会话自动开启 ponytail 模式。

@shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail README · 安装：```bash
git clone https://github.com/shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail.git
```

用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，target 指向本目录的绝对路径。
安装影响该 profile 的所有会话，重启后依然有效；卸载在 设置 → Plugins 里删除。

`install_bundle` 记下的是 `link:` 指向，profile 直接用这个克隆目录，不复制文件。所以：

- **不要移动或删除克隆目录**：下次启动解析不到插件，技能会消失。
- 更新用 `git pull`，然后重启 DeepSeek Harness（`entry.js` 是插件代码，要重启才加载新模块）。
- 每个 profile 各装一次；只装在 `desktop` 的插件，在 `web` profile 里不会出现。

包本身是 `private`，不发布到 npm；安装只走上面的本地目录方式。

@shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail README · 使用：在输入框敲 `/` 从菜单选，或直接敲技能名（如 `/ponytail-review`）；
名字后面带词会一并送出（如 `/ponytail ultra`）。模型也可以通过 `skill` 工具按名加载。

@shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail README · 使用：| 技能 | 触发 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `ponytail` | `/ponytail` | 懒人资深模式本体：最小改动、一行回复说清跳过了什么、有什么风险。`/ponytail lite\|full\|ultra` 切换档位。 |
| `ponytail-review` | `/ponytail-review` | 审一次改动：bug、安全、负载、缺测试、慢、能删的代码。 |
| `ponytail-audit` | `/ponytail-audit` | 同样的质量审查，作用于整个仓库，按重要性排序。 |
| `ponytail-debt` | `/ponytail-debt` | 收集 `shortcut:` 注释，输出欠账清单。 |
| `ponytail-gain` | `/ponytail-gain` | 展示基准测试测得的收益。 |
| `ponytail-help` | `/ponytail-help` | 速查卡。 |

@shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail README · 自动启用：插件开启时，每个会话自动进入 ponytail 模式（档位 **full**）：
`ponytail` 技能正文作为系统提示词段注入，从第一步起生效，子代理同样生效。
注入段只对**编码与仓库类任务**生效（写代码、修 bug、重构、评审、选依赖）；
做调研、写信、答问不套用这些规则。

- 换档：`/ponytail-mode lite\|full\|ultra`（推荐，直接改状态）；`/ponytail lite` 也仍可用
- 本会话退出：`/ponytail-mode off`，或说 "stop ponytail" / "normal mode"
- 所有会话不再自动启用：设置 → Plugins 里停用本插件

@shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail README · 自动启用：`/ponytail-mode` 走 Harness 的命令面（不生成模型消息、不消耗 token），handler 直接改插件状态：
注入段在下一步就按新档位重渲染，**关掉时整段从系统提示词移除**。因此它不依赖模型记住指令，
上下文压缩或多轮之后也不会"复活"。状态按会话保存在内存里，子代理继承父会话的档位，
重启应用后回到 **full**。不传参数（`/ponytail-mode`）会显示当前档位。

@shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail README · 与上游的差异：- 6 个技能正文取自上游 `skills/` 目录，方法论未改；frontmatter 的 `description` 改为单行——**本插件只解析单行标量**，
  遇到上游那种 `description: >` 折叠写法会直接报错并跳过该技能（Harness 自身能正常解析多行，
  限制来自这里的手写解析器）；上游的 `argument-hint`、`license` 两个字段不再保留
  （技能调用与许可分别由 Harness 与 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 负责）。
- `ponytail-review` / `ponytail-audit` 的输出语言改为**跟随用户语言**（上游写死 “Very simple English”），
  报告的四段式结构与示例未变。
- `ponytail` 正文里「换档/退出」那一行按 Harness 的表述重写。
- 新增 `/ponytail-mode lite\|full\|ultra\|off` 命令：换档与退出不再只靠提示词自律，
  而是直接改插件状态，注入段随之下一步重渲染（off 时整段移除）；上游没有对应机制。
- 注入段增加的 scope 限定：只对编码与仓库类任务生效，非编码任务不套用。
- `ponytail-help` 的调用与更新说明改写为 Harness 的 `/` 菜单与 设置 → Plugins，
  并订正更新生效条件（正文下次加载生效，description 与 `entry.js` 需重启）。
- `ponytail-gain` 的条形图说明改为方块字符（示例本就用 `█`/`·`，原说明误写为 ASCII）。
- 新增 skill provider 注册与系统提示词自动注入：上游靠各宿主自行加载、只在被调用时生效。

@shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail README · 结构：```
package.json            bundle 清单，dsh.bundle.patch 指向补丁
cordis.patch.yml        插入一行 ponytail
entry.js                Host 插件：注册 skill provider + 每会话注入 ponytail 系统提示词段
assets/<name>/SKILL.md  六个技能正文（name/description 在 YAML frontmatter）

@shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail README · 结构：技能正文以 `SKILL.md` 为准，`description` 从 frontmatter 单行读出。
改 `SKILL.md` 的**正文**，对 `/ponytail-*` 的调用立即生效（技能加载时才读盘）；但插件开启时注入的
ponytail 规则是**加载时的快照**，改完 `ponytail/SKILL.md` 正文后，那段系统提示词要重启
DeepSeek Harness 才更新（重启前技能正文与注入段会不一致）。**`description` 同样在插件加载时
读出并缓存，改后需重启**。改 `entry.js` 属于替换已安装包的代码，也需要重启才会加载新一代模块。

@shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail README · @shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail · Ponytail for DeepSeek Harness：**English** | [中文](README.md)

DeepSeek Harness plugin port of [Ponytail](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail)
(the lazy senior dev mode: solve the problem with the smallest change, and explain it
in one read). One install puts all 6 skills into the `/` menu and the model's skill
catalog — and turns on ponytail mode in every session automatically.

@shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail README · Install：```bash
git clone https://github.com/shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail.git
```

Use `plugin_manager`'s `install_bundle` with the target pointing at the absolute
path of this directory. The install affects every session of the profile and survives
restarts. Remove it in Settings → Plugins.

`install_bundle` records a `link:` to this clone and the profile loads it in place —
no copy is made. So:

@shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail README · Install：- **Do not move or delete the clone**: the next start cannot resolve the plugin and
  the skills disappear.
- Update with `git pull`, then restart DeepSeek Harness (`entry.js` is plugin code and
  needs a restart to load the new module).
- Install once per profile; a plugin installed only in `desktop` does not appear in `web`.

The package is `private` and is not published to npm; install it from the local
directory as described above.

@shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail README · Usage：| Skill | Trigger | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `ponytail` | `/ponytail` | The lazy senior mode itself: the smallest change, and a closing note on what was skipped and any risk. `/ponytail lite\|full\|ultra` switches level. |
| `ponytail-review` | `/ponytail-review` | Review one change: bugs, security, load, missing tests, slowness, cuttable code. |
| `ponytail-audit` | `/ponytail-audit` | The same quality review across the whole repo, ranked. |
| `ponytail-debt` | `/ponytail-debt` | Collect `shortcut:` comments into a debt ledger. |
| `ponytail-gain` | `/ponytail-gain` | Show the benchmarked savings. |
| `ponytail-help` | `/ponytail-help` | Quick reference card. |

@shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail README · Auto-activation：With the plugin enabled, every session starts in ponytail mode (level **full**):
the `ponytail` skill body is injected as a system-prompt section, effective from the
first step, for the agent and every subagent. The section applies to **coding and repo
work only** (writing, fixing, refactoring, reviewing, choosing dependencies); research
questions, email and prose are left alone.

@shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail README · Differences from upstream：- The 6 skill bodies come from upstream's `skills/` directory with the methodology
  unchanged; the frontmatter `description` was flattened to a single line because
  **this plugin reads single-line scalars only** — a folded `description: >` is rejected
  with an error and the skill is skipped (Harness itself parses multi-line YAML fine; the
  limit is the hand-written parser here). Upstream's `argument-hint` / `license` fields
  are dropped (invocation and licensing are handled by Harness and
  [LICENSE](LICENSE) respectively).
- `ponytail-review` / `ponytail-audit` report in **the user's language** instead of
  upstream's hard-coded "Very simple English"; the four-part finding structure and the
  examples are unchanged.
- The "switch level / leave the mode" line in the `ponytail` body was reworded for Harness.
- Added `/ponytail-mode lite\|full\|ultra\|off`: switching no longer relies on the model
  obeying the prompt — the command updates plugin state and the section re-renders on the
  next step (`off` removes it); upstream has no equivalent.
- The injected section now states its scope: coding and repo work on

@shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail README · Layout：```
package.json            bundle manifest; dsh.bundle.patch points at the patch
cordis.patch.yml        inserts one ponytail line
entry.js                host plugin: registers the skill provider + injects the
                        ponytail system-prompt section every session

@shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail README · Layout：The skill body is whatever `SKILL.md` says; `description` is read from the
single-line frontmatter. Editing a `SKILL.md` **body** is picked up by `/ponytail-*`
invocations immediately (the file is read when the skill loads), but the ponytail rules
injected on activation are a **snapshot taken at plugin load**: after editing
`ponytail/SKILL.md`, the system-prompt section still holds the old text until DeepSeek
Harness restarts (so the two disagree until then). Its **`description`** is likewise
read and cached when the plugin loads. Editing `entry.js` replaces installed package
code and also needs a restart to load the new module.

@shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail README · Attribution：The skill bodies (`assets/*/SKILL.md`) are adapted from the `skills/` directory of
[DietrichGebert/ponytail](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail), published under
